# pbs_realms (Data Source)

Lists the realms of a Proxmox Backup Server, the places users sign in at, as the sign-in form offers them: the built-in `pam` and `pbs`, and the OpenID Connect, LDAP and Active Directory realms. PBS shows the list to anyone, so it needs no privileges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_realms" "all" {}

# The realm the sign-in form preselects, if any.
output "default_realm" {
  value = one([for r in data.pbs_realms.all.realms : r.realm if r.default])
}

# The OpenID Connect realms.
output "openid_realms" {
  value = [for r in data.pbs_realms.all.realms : r.realm if r.type == "openid"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `realms` (Attributes List) The realms, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--realms))

<a id="nestedatt--realms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `realms`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether the sign-in form preselects the realm; true for one realm at most.
- `realm` (String) Realm name, such as `pam` or `authentik`; users of the realm are `<name>@<realm>`.
- `type` (String) Type of the realm: `pam`, `pbs`, `openid`, `ldap` or `ad`.
